title: VTC Vetting — Vetter Grants — List — payload
description: An administrator pages through every vetter grant the community has made. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

limit.description: Page size. The community chooses when absent (50 in the reference implementation).

GrantOrigin.title: GrantOrigin
GrantOrigin.description: Who issued the grant. `auto`: the automatic-grant sweep (vtc/vetting/auto-grant), on the vetter-eligibility policy's allow — and the only grants that sweep ever revokes. `manual`: an administrator, through vtc/vetting/vetters/grant.

VetterProfileSummary.title: VetterProfileSummary
VetterProfileSummary.description: What an administrator sees of a vetter's self-published profile (vtc/vetting/vetters/profile). Self-asserted by the vetter; a surface rendering it attributes it to them.

listed.description: Whether the profile appears in vtc/vetting/vetters/list.

eventCount.description: How many events the profile lists, ended or not.

updatedAt.description: When the profile was last published.

endorsementId.description: The grant's record — what vtc/endorsements/revoke withdraws.

validUntil.description: The credential's `validUntil`. Absent on a grant recorded before the community kept it.

revoked.description: Whether the grant has been revoked.

revokedAt.description: When it was revoked. Present only when `revoked`.

live.description: Unrevoked, unexpired, and held by a current member — the predicate vtc/vetting/vetters/show reports as `live`.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Vetter Grants — List — response payload

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.
